title: Marketing Operations Specialist
description:
About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role: 

This role sits at the center of how marketing scales at AlphaSense. As a Marketing Operations Specialist, you will help bring campaigns to life by powering execution, ensuring quality, and strengthening the operational foundation that enables marketing to move faster and smarter. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Demand Generation, Events, and Marketing leadership to ensure programs launch cleanly, consistently, and in alignment with best practices.

This position offers the opportunity to gain hands-on experience in marketing automation, campaign governance, and scalable program frameworks while contributing directly to the success of high-impact marketing initiatives. You’ll play a key role in evolving how our systems, processes, and standards support a growing global organization.

Your success in this role requires a strong operational mindset, attention to detail, and comfort working within structured processes-paired with curiosity and a desire to improve how things work. You enjoy problem-solving, take pride in high-quality execution, and communicate clearly with a wide range of stakeholders. This is an ideal role for someone looking to grow into a more advanced Marketing Operations, Marketing Technology, or Revenue Operations career path

Who You Are:

• 1-3 years of experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, or campaign support.

• Working knowledge of Marketo or another marketing automation platform (Marketo strongly preferred).

• Strong attention to detail and comfort with QA processes, checklists, and documentation.

• Ability to follow established processes while also contributing to their continuous improvement.

• Clear written communication skills for documentation and internal enablement.

• Comfortable managing intake requests and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
Nice to Have (But Not Required)

• Experience supporting event marketing or webinar programs

• Familiarity with tokens, templates, and scalable program frameworks

• Experience working in a B2B marketing environment

• Exposure to change management or internal communications

What You’ll Do:  

Powering Campaign Execution

• Support the execution of marketing campaigns by creating and managing programs, ensuring data accuracy and readiness

• Own intake and complete program builds for select stakeholders, helping teams move faster while staying aligned to best practices

• Clone approved program templates and populate program data using provided token information for review and approval

Ensuring Quality, Consistency & Scale

• Review and QA programs built by teams with Marketo access, helping maintain a high bar for quality, consistency, and scalability

title: Staff Software Engineer, Mobile Security
description:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

 

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.

OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

 

About The Opportunity

We are looking for a Staff Mobile Security Engineer to join our Mobile Security team, where you will play a key role in identifying and mitigating security vulnerabilities across OKX's mobile applications and platforms. This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of offensive security, mobile engineering, and platform protection - you will work closely with development, operations, and compliance teams to ensure security is embedded at every layer of our mobile stack.

You bring deep expertise in mobile application security, offensive techniques, and secure coding practices. You are also fluent in AI-assisted development and bring the discipline to build, maintain, and continuously improve your own AI engineering workflows.

 

What You'll Be Doing

•
Identify and address security vulnerabilities in mobile code, systems, and networks through manual review, automated tooling, and threat modelling.

• Manage and optimise application security tools, processes, and alerts to maintain a strong security posture.

• Validate and respond to Bug Bounty submissions, triaging findings and coordinating remediation with engineering teams.

• Produce detailed security findings reports and present them to both technical and management audiences, contributing to real-world attack prevention.

• Collaborate with development teams to implement and champion secure coding practices across iOS and Android platforms.

• Apply AI tools to accelerate security research, automate vulnerability detection workflows, and improve the efficiency of threat analysis.

• Work alongside operations and compliance teams to ensure security is a consistent priority across the organisation.

• Participate in incident response and management activities.

• Stay current on the latest offensive security techniques, application security threats, and industry best practices.

 

What We Look For In You

• 5+ years of experience in mobile application security or offensive security, with hands-on expertise in iOS and/or Android platforms.

• In-depth understanding of security risks, vulnerabilities, and concepts in mobile and web applications.

• Proficient in code review across Kotlin, Swift, TypeScript, or JavaScript, with a strong grasp of application security threats.

• Able to create proof-of-concepts (PoCs) to demonstrate vulnerabilities, review patch code for adherence to standards, and collaborate with repository owners on remediation.

• Actively uses AI tools in your security engineering workflow - including building AI-leveraged workflows and codifying repeatable agent skills so tools like Claude Code or Codex deliver reliably on real production work.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with excellent verbal and written communication skills.

 

Nice-To-Haves

• Prior experience developing mobile security SDKs at scale - products with a daily active user base of over ten million.

title: Assistant Manager Tax (Finance)
description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries , Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively , including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto 's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

As Sprinto scales globally, tax becomes more than a compliance function-it becomes a strategic advantage. Every new market we enter, every entity we build, and every commercial decision we make brings new tax considerations that need thoughtful, business-first solutions.

You'll own Sprinto 's global tax operations across direct tax, indirect tax, and cross-border compliance, ensuring we stay compliant while enabling the business to move quickly and confidently. From working with external advisors and regulators to partnering with Finance, Legal, and Leadership, you'll help build a tax function that's scalable, resilient, and ready for the next phase of Sprinto 's growth.

If you're looking for a role where you'll move beyond filings and become a strategic partner in building a global SaaS company, this is that opportunity.

Where you'll leave your mark?

•
Build a global tax engine - Design and strengthen tax processes that scale with Sprinto 's international growth, ensuring compliance keeps pace with business expansion-not the other way around.

•
Turn complexity into clarity - Navigate direct tax, indirect tax, withholding tax, and cross-border regulations across multiple jurisdictions, translating evolving regulations into practical business decisions.

•
Be the trusted voice on tax - Partner with Finance, Legal, and business leaders to provide commercial guidance on new markets, entity structures, contracts, and strategic initiatives-bringing tax into decisions before it becomes a problem.

•
Keep Sprinto audit-ready - Lead statutory, tax, and regulatory audits with confidence, building strong controls and governance that create trust with auditors, regulators, and leadership alike.

•
Build systems, not spreadsheets - Continuously improve compliance processes, reporting, and automation so the tax function becomes more scalable, efficient, and resilient as Sprinto grows.

•
Help shape the finance organisation - Contribute beyond tax by collaborating on month-end close

title: Contracts Associate - Full Time

Your focus will be on drafting, reviewing, and maintaining contracts with payers, vendors, and partners, ensuring they align perfectly with our organizational goals and regulatory requirements. As a Contracts Associate, you will be a go-to resource for contract-related inquiries, assist in developing innovative contract templates, and help coordinate contract processes across various departments.
Responsibilities:

• Assist in drafting, reviewing, and revising contracts to ensure accuracy and compliance.

• Support negotiations by preparing documentation and analyzing proposed terms.

• Maintain centralized systems for tracking contract status, renewals, and compliance requirements.

• Ensure timely execution and storage of agreements for audit readiness.

• Serve as a resource for TCN members regarding contract-related inquiries and processes.

• Prepare templates and guidance documents for members to streamline contracting activities.

• Collaborate with compliance and risk teams to ensure contracts meet regulatory and quality standards.

• Maintain HIPAA Business Associate Agreements and update as needed.

• Work closely with payer engagement, credentialing, and finance teams to align contract terms with operational needs.

• Develop and maintain operational and recordkeeping systems for efficient performance and audit records of TCN and member contracts and agreements.

• Prepare support resources for members and internal use.

• Connect with other TCN employees to ensure coordination of contracts between departments, as indicated.

• Strive to create and enhance the quality of contract-related product offerings to TCN members and clients.

• Assist with process improvement activities that will benefit core duties.

• Provide standard and ad hoc reports in user-friendly formats to TCN leaders and members.

• Resolve all work-related problems promptly and use good judgment in escalating important issues to leadership.

• Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

• Associate’s degree or certificate in relevant field, or equivalent experience.

• 1-3 years’ experience in a fast-paced environment, preferably with healthcare focus.

• Knowledge of contract language, negotiation principles, and contract management systems.

• Familiarity with HIPAA privacy rules and healthcare regulatory guidelines.

• Active learner, innovative, with a drive to research and understand compliance, contracting, and credentialing.

• Healthcare experience preferred.

TCN is committed to the work of anti-racism and pursuit of diversity, equity, and inclusion, to foster a safe and transformational environment for staff and patients to work, receive care, and thrive in their everyday lives. We strongly encourage all interested individuals to apply, even if they are not confident, they meet 100% of the listed qualifications, and allow us to evaluate candidates’ knowledge, skills, and abilities using an intentional equity lens.

title: User Acquisition Manager (Performance)
description:
ABOUT US

Founded in the US in 2022 and now based in London, UK, Recraft is an AI tool for professional designers, illustrators, and marketers, setting a new standard for excellence in image generation.

We designed a tool that lets creators quickly generate and iterate original images, vector art, illustrations, icons, and 3D graphics with AI. Over 3 million users across 190+ countries have produced hundreds of millions of images using Recraft, and we're just getting started.

Join a universe of professional opportunities, develop and support large-scale projects, and shape the future of creativity. We are committed to making Recraft an essential, daily tool for every designer and setting the industry standard. Our mission is to ensure that creators can fully control their creative process with AI, providing them with innovative tools to turn ideas into reality.

If you’re passionate about pushing the boundaries of AI, we want you on board!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Growth at Recraft is a numbers problem before it's a brand problem. We're looking for a UA Manager who owns paid acquisition end to end: setting up the channels, scaling spend without breaking payback, and knowing which lever moved the number. This is a hands-in-the-accounts role, not an agency-management one - and for the right person, a chance to build the performance marketing engine at Recraft from scratch and scale it toward $1M/month.

One thing to know about the model, because it shapes the job: we don't run a free trial. New users get a pack of free credits, and once they need more, the only way forward is a paid subscription. That means conversion often happens on day one, and the numbers that matter are free-to-paid conversion rate, renewal, and payback by cohort - not trial starts.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own paid user acquisition on Meta first - account structure, targeting, bidding, budget pacing, and daily optimization. Meta is where the majority of the budget sits and where we expect the majority of your time to go.

- Open and scale the next channels as Meta matures: Google (Search, PMax, YouTube, App) and TikTok.

- Scale monthly spend aggressively while holding CAC, ROAS, and cohort payback targets. Growth without payback discipline doesn't count.

- Build what isn't there yet: tracking, attribution, naming conventions, dashboards, and reporting - so decisions are made on data everyone trusts.

- Own subscription economics, not vanity metrics: free-to-paid conversion, day-one subscription rate, renewal and churn by month, ARPPU, and LTV by cohort and by channel.

- Run a structured testing cadence on audiences, placements, bidding, and offers - and brief creative based on what the data says, working directly with our Creative Designer.

- Automate the repetitive parts of the job - reporting, pacing, anomaly alerts, creative rotation - using Claude and platform APIs, so your time goes to decisions rather than spreadsheets.

- Forecast and plan budget, and report weekly on spend, CAC, and payback to marketing and leadership.

WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH

You'll join the Marketing team and work closely with our Performance Marketing Manager, Creative Designer, and the analytics and product teams. This is a role built around owning a number and bringing your own plan for hitting it, not executing someone else's media plan.

REQUIREMENTS

- 4+ years in user acquisition or performance marketing for a consumer subscription product - app, web, or both.

- Deep, hands-on Meta expertise. You've run Meta as a primary acquisition channel at meaningful spend, built the account structure yourself, and can explain how you handled the moments where scaling stopped working.

- You've managed a paid budget of at least $100k/month and can walk us through what CAC and payback did as you scaled it.

- Experience setting up performance marketing from scratch - accounts, pixels and server-side events, MMP/SKAN or GA4, attribution logic, and reporting.

- Fluency in subscription econ

title: Clinical Medical Monitor

The Opportunity

Great clinical development depends on strong medical judgment in the moments that matter: when an investigator has a question, a safety event needs assessment, or emerging data require action. At Praxis, you’ll provide hands-on medical oversight for assigned clinical programs, with patient safety and study quality at the center. You’ll support investigators and sites on eligibility, dosing, safety events, and other medical questions; review clinical and safety data; assess serious adverse events; and identify emerging signals or trends. • Safety and regulatory compliance: Ensure medical monitoring, safety assessment, escalation, and documentation meet applicable regulatory requirements, GCP standards, and study protocols.

• Cross-functional partnership: Work closely with clinical development, clinical operations, safety/pharmacovigilance, biostatistics, data management, and regulatory colleagues to resolve issues and support high-quality study execution.

• Strong clinical judgment and demonstrated ability to assess AEs and SAEs consistently and rigorously.

• Ability to review clinical data, recognize meaningful patterns or potential safety signals, and determine when action or additional surveillance is needed.

• Working knowledge of GCP, clinical trial safety reporting requirements, and documentation standards.

- Design and maintain KPI dashboards and reporting frameworks that give leadership real-time visibility into the metrics that matter.

- Track and report on SaaS metrics - ARR, NRR, CAC, LTV, churn, and cohort performance - ensuring finance and commercial reporting are aligned.

- Partner with the Finance Systems Lead to ensure reporting infrastructure is built on clean, timely data from source systems.

- Support the build-out of investor-facing outputs as the business approaches future milestones.

BUSINESS PARTNERING

- Support business partnering across commercial, product, and operational teams - building relationships, developing financial insight, and adding value beyond the numbers.

- Understand the sales pipeline, analyse revenue performance, and help the business make better decisions.

- Support hiring decisions and headcount planning with clear financial analysis, working with Talent and functional leads to track actuals against plan.

- Provide ad hoc analysis and decision support across the business - building the case for investment, surfacing risks, and identifying opportunities.

title: Mid Market Account Executive, Toast Retail
description:
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding into new food and beverage concepts: convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. The Toast Retail platform is already winning with independent operators. Now we are moving upmarket, and this is one of the key sales roles that proves the commercial motion as we pursue increasingly complex retail accounts.
Role Overview
As a founding Mid Market Account Executive for Toast Retail, you will source and close multi-location retail deals with a focus on grocery, liquor, and convenience operators. These are complex accounts with real buying committees, layered compliance requirements, deep inventory and SKU demands, and incumbent systems that took years to entrench. Winning them requires a sales motion that does not fully exist at Toast Retail yet. You will help build it, one deal at a time.
This is not a role for someone who wants to inherit a finished playbook. Some proof points exist from our SMB business, leadership is investing, and there is a set of open questions that closers in the field have to go answer. What does discovery look like when the buyer is a VP of Operations and not an owner? Which SMB motions translate upmarket and which have to be rebuilt? What do we need from Product to be credible in a 40 store grocery chain? You will form hypotheses, test them in live deals, and feed what works back so the next AEs can run it.
You will report to the Manager, Mid Market Sales, Toast Retail. This is a remote opportunity with travel expectations of 30% or more, including store walks and on site visits.
A day in the life (Responsibilities)

•
Pipeline and prospecting: Build a qualified pipeline of multi-location grocery, liquor, and convenience operators through category research, cold calling, networking, and close partnership with our SMB Retail teams to identify accounts ready to move upmarket.

•
Retail centric discovery: Run disciplined discovery against buying committees rather than single owners. Learn the operational realities that move a category buyer, from inventory depth and scan data to shrink, margin, and compliance, and turn them into a compelling case for Toast Retail.

•
Value based selling: Create demand by educating prospects on the Toast Retail value proposition through demonstrations and tailored business cases. Sell on platform value and outcomes over price, and help operators understand which products actually fit their scale.

•
Full lifecycle ownership: Own the entire journey, from lead development and financial structuring to contract negotiation and close. Collaborate with Account Service and Implementation to ensure a seamless handoff on retail installs that are meaningfully harder than a single site.

•
Complex deal navigation: Manage lengthy sales cycles with real ambiguity. Multithread across operations, finance, IT, and merchandising, and develop champions inside layered retail organizations.

•
Internal collaboration: Partner with Legal, Deal Desk, Biz Ops, and Finance to structure deals, and hold your ground in negotiations so terms align with Toast 's goals. Work with Product, Marketing, and Enablement to close the gaps between us and a repeatable Mid Market Retail motion, and escalate the ones you cannot close yourself.

•
Build as you close: Convert what works in your live deals into discovery notes, demo flows, and business case models the next AEs can run. Distinguish a repeatable process from a one off hero deal, and help codify the former.

•
Voice of the retailer: Bring the Mid Market retailer's needs back into the product roadmap with specificity and evidence, not anecdotes.

•
Revenue mindset: Optimize for long term realized revenue, not just bookings. Evaluate the full financial impact of every deal, ask what it will actually cost us, and make thoughtful trade offs on pricing, discounts, and terms while protecting Toast 's bottom line.

•

Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your impact

Axon equips the world's public safety agencies with technology that captures truth, improves accountability, and protects lives. Our products run from body-worn cameras that de-escalate critical encounters to in-car systems, interview room solutions, mobile apps, and a growing set of signals and sensors. How officers stay connected in the field is central to all of it, and that is where the next opportunity sits.

You will lead a team of product managers to define a new product built from the ground up across hardware, software, and cloud, the first entry in a zero-to-one portfolio with the potential to become one of Axon's biggest pillars. In this role you help shape the product strategy, drive definition and prioritization with your team, and partner across the organization to move it forward. Your work helps determine whether agencies adopt the product and officers trust it in the field. The role reports to the CEO of Axon 911.

State of the business

The opportunity is a 0-to-1 business. You will build the product from scratch, and the ceiling is large enough to make it one of Axon's biggest pillars.

• The target category is large, underserved, and central to how public safety agencies operate in the field.

• The new device generation moves agencies onto a single connected platform, similar to the move from a feature phone to a smartphone.

• Success in the early phase means winning the first agency deployments and proving field reliability, then expanding across [target segments: e.g., large municipal agencies, state police, federal.]

The role

You lead the product across strategy, definition, and execution alongside your team. You help shape the vision and the roadmap, work through the trade-offs that engineering and design build against, and keep the program moving from first prototype toward large-scale agency deployment. You partner with engineering, design, hardware, supply chain, and go-to-market leaders, and you help carry the product narrative to executives, agency decision-makers, and the field.

Responsibilities include:

• Product strategy: Own the multi-year vision, target segments, and the sequence of bets that get the product from early deployments to large-scale adoption. Own the full product lifecycle from definition through go-to-market and iteration.

• Definition and execution: Turn how officers work and communicate in the field into clear product requirements. Own the roadmap and the trade-offs across performance, reliability, battery life, security, and cost.

• Customer obsession: Build direct relationships with agency leaders and officers. Start from the customer problem and ground every major decision in customer evidence and field data.

• Cross-functional leadership: Partner with hardware, firmware, cloud, and design engineering leaders to turn device and system constraints into product decisions, and with go-to-market teams to land deployments that hold up in the field.

• Team building: Hire, coach, and lead a team of product managers. Set the bar for written thinking, customer discovery, and measurable outcomes.

• Accountability: Define the metrics that show whether the product is working (adoption, field reliability, officer trust) and report against them honestly, including when the data says a bet was wrong.

description:
Joining Mines Saint-Étienne means committing to an institution where science and innovation build a more sustainable future . It is a school of excellence where everyone has the opportunity to unlock their full potential and contribute to tackling the challenges of tomorrow .
Ranked among the top engineering schools in France and recognized worldwide, our school, a member of the Institut Mines-Télécom , educates the talents of tomorrow while actively addressing major industrial, digital, and environmental challenges. By joining us, you become part of a community of 500 members of staff, 2,500 students and take part in an ambitious project: combining academic excellence, cutting-edge research, and positive societal impact.
The Institut Mines-Télécom brings together France’s leading Grandes Ecoles to tackle major industrial, digital, energy, and environmental challenges. With its eight public Grandes Écoles and two affiliated Graduate Schools, it is the leading public institute dedicated to engineers and managers. Together, we imagine and build a sustainable future by educating the leaders who will shape tomorrow’s transitions.

🎯 What we expect from you ?

As an intern, you will perform innovation and research activities in the field of soft electronics for eskin applications. Within this centre of Microelectronics and the flexible electronics department, you will combine your passion for science and for societal impact.
The flexible electronics department develops technological and scientific knowledge in the field of soft electronics. The department has a strong knowledge in the field of material and interface electrical and mechanical characterization. The activities of the department are regrouped in the 660m2-area platform. This technological platform regroups facilities and technological equipment for R&D activities in Micropackaging, micro and nano-electronics, in a clean room of 220m² 1000-class and 400m² 10000-class.

Stretchable electronics can also be declined with optical systems such as waveguides. These devices will be developed within the project in order to create an artificial skin with pressure and temperature sensing capabilities.

Within this project , our work will focus on the fabrication and characterization of stretchable optical waveguides as well as fabrication and integration techniques of optical components (LEDs / Photodiodes). Related publication is “Transparent, Optical, Pressure‐Sensitive Artificial Skin for Large‐Area Stretchable Electronics” https://doi.org/10.1002/adma.201200523 .
An important part of the work will be:
· Update our characterization setup è knowledge in Python and electronics (Arduino & Rasperry Pi) is important
· Fabrication and characterization of these waveguide (elastomer) for pressure or temperature sensors applications.
· Integration of optically pressure or temperature sensitive material into the elastomer waveguide
· Characterization of the complete devices.

Fabrication process and experimental setups are already existing. However, knowledges in Python is important in order to use these test benches. Hands-on lab work is essential , and will be partly performed in our clean room facility.
Demonstrations of radically new devices, possessing features and functions that cannot be achieved with existing electronics would be the exciting outcome of this work.

🔍 What we are looking for ?

You hold a:
· Master and engineer students in engineering sciences, electronics and embedded systems, material science or a related field.
And you have:
• Basic knowledge of electronic design and circuitry would be highly appreciated
• You should be autonomous, curious, and passionate about technological innovation.
• A strong interest in practical work and experimentation is essential, along with the ability to develop a rigorous scientific approach in the spirit of a "maker" culture.
• Knowledge in bioelectronics is an asset

Role

Formulate clear, data-driven recommendations based on your analyses.

Contribute to the monthly risk cycle, Risk Committees, ongoing projects and the monthly risk report.
Communicate clearly with country CEOs, local Risk teams, CPM, ERM and senior stakeholders.
